title: Brevard County Commission, District 1
what_it_does: County commissioners set the county budget and property-tax (millage) rate, adopt land-use and zoning rules, and oversee county services such as roads, parks, libraries, fire/EMS and utilities.

candidates.name: Aldon Bookhardt
candidates.background: Democratic candidate for Brevard County Commission District 1. His campaign is built on 'Rights, Resources, and Responsibility': taxpayers have a right to see county resources at work in their neighborhood, with commissioners holding department heads accountable for potholes, drainage ditches and easements, plus 'rights to clean water'. No positions on the guide's county issues were stated as of Sept. 18, 2026 (campaign site).

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

housing.summary: Proposes requiring every new rental development of 50 or more units to set aside at least 10% of units for workforce and moderate-income households for at least 30 years, with density bonuses and fee reductions for developers, plus streamlining zoning and fast-tracking affordable and tiny-home projects.
housing.quote: Require 10% Affordable Units – Every new rental development of 50+ units must set aside at least 10% of its homes for workforce and moderate-income households.

sources.title: What We're Hearing - Aldon Bookhardt for Brevard County Commission Seat 1 (accessed 2026-10-07)
Our Priorities - Aldon Bookhardt for Brevard County Commission Seat 1 (accessed 2026-10-07)

environment.summary: Lists protecting the Indian River Lagoon as a priority and proposes independent monthly water testing with every result made public; his campaign also lists 'rights to clean water'.
environment.quote: The Indian River Lagoon isn't just nature – it's our economy, our tourism, our home.

sources.title: Our Priorities - Aldon Bookhardt for Brevard County Commission Seat 1 (accessed 2026-10-07)

growth.summary: Says he does not oppose growth but wants residents heard, proposing evening neighborhood 'community impact meetings' with free childcare for developments over 50 homes; at the same time he proposes cutting red tape and fast-tracking approvals for affordable housing projects.
growth.quote: We don't hate growth. We hate growth that ignores us.

sources.title: Our Priorities - Aldon Bookhardt for Brevard County Commission Seat 1 (accessed 2026-10-07)

crime.summary: His public-safety plan is community policing with the Brevard County Sheriff, with deputies on bikes and in neighborhoods; he does not address penalties or overall police funding levels.
crime.quote: Community policing with Brevard County Sheriff—on bikes, on the ground, and in the community. Not just watching over it. Being part of it.

sources.title: Our Priorities - Aldon Bookhardt for Brevard County Commission Seat 1 (accessed 2026-10-07)

candidates.name: Nathan Slusher
candidates.occupation: Small-business owner (NRAYS LLC); chair, Libertarian Party of Brevard County
candidates.background: Libertarian Nathan Slusher is a Titusville native and Titusville High School graduate who owns a maintenance business and chairs the Libertarian Party of Brevard County. He was the Libertarian candidate for the District 1 seat in 2024 and had earlier run for Titusville City Council. His 2026 platform centers on repairing drainage, potholes and other infrastructure during the shortened two-year term.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

growth.summary: Says he would vote no on all new development until the surrounding infrastructure is repaired, and makes repairing storm drains, potholes, canals and sewer pipes his top reason for running.
growth.quote: Vote No on all new development, until the surrounding infrastructure is repaired

property_tax.summary: Libertarian Party profile says he is working on a plan to remove property taxes while still funding the county.
property_tax.quote: working to create a plan to remove property taxes while still funding the county

taxes.summary: His platform says Brevard County taxes have only gone up over the last 10 years, that protecting the county's tax cap is the bare minimum, and that government should cut its budget as households have; he calls for ending excessive spending.
taxes.quote: Protecting The Tax Cap is the absolute bare minimum any candidate should be doing.

sources.title: Platform - Nathan Slusher, Libertarian for Brevard County Commission District 1 (accessed 2026-10-07)

crime.summary: Says he stands with firefighters, the Sheriff's Office, police and emergency management and would ensure staff are properly paid and their facilities kept in good condition. He does not address criminal penalties.
crime.quote: I stand with our firefighters, emergency responders, and emergency management. This includes ensuring our staff is properly paid and the infrastructure of their facilities stay in top working condition.
